QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_34

question.text: Per Ch 9 (Box 9.2), AIFs compliant with Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) must present annual performance for a MINIMUM of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Box 9.2: GIPS-compliant AIFs must present minimum 5 years (or since inception), building prospectively to 10 years. The Trap: Options A, B are below GIPS threshold. Option D is the full build-out, not minimum. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B touches on GIPS; XXI-B requires GIPS for PMS aspirants. Manager's Pro-Tip: GIPS verification is optional but signals institutional quality to global LPs. Budget INR 10-25 lakh annually for an external GIPS verifier if targeting sovereign wealth fund or pension fund capital.
